Introduction

At STN IT Enterprise, your privacy is our top priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you interact with our website (https://stnitenterprise.com/) or use our services. By accessing our platform, you agree to the practices described below.
Information We Collect
2.1 Personal Data
We may collect the following when you use our services:
– Identifiers: Name, email address, phone number, and physical address (e.g., for shipping or service delivery).
– Payment Details: Credit/debit card information or other payment data, securely processed through third-party gateways (e.g., PayPal, Stripe).
2.2 Non-Personal Data
– Technical Information: Browser type, device type, IP address, and operating system.
– Usage Analytics: Pages visited, session duration, and interactions with our platform.
How We Use Your Information
3.1 Service Delivery
– Process orders, manage accounts, and provide customer support.
– Send order confirmations, service updates, or transactional notifications.
3.2 Marketing Communication
– Share promotional offers, newsletters, or company updates only with your explicit consent.
3.3 Platform Optimization
– Analyze user behavior to improve website functionality and user experience.
Data Protection
4.1 Security Measures
– We use industry-standard encryption, firewalls, and secure servers to protect your data from unauthorized access.
4.2 Third-Party Sharing
– We do not sell or rent your personal data.
– Data may be shared with trusted partners essential to our operations (e.g., payment processors, shipping providers, IT service providers).
Your Rights
5.1 Access & Control
– Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at sales@stnitenterprise.com.
5.2 Opt-Out Options
– Unsubscribe from marketing emails via the “Unsubscribe” link in all promotional communications.
5.3 Regulatory Compliance
– We adhere to applicable privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). If covered under these regulations, you may lodge complaints with relevant authorities.
Contact us
for questions or requests related to this policy:
– Email: sales@stnitenterprise.com
– Address: 7901 4th St N 17149 St. Petersburg, FL 33702

Return and Exchange Policy
STN IT Enterprise Return & Exchange Policy
Our Commitment
At STN IT Enterprise, we strive to deliver quality products and ensure your satisfaction. However, if something goes wrong, here’s how we handle returns and exchanges:
Return & Exchange Conditions
You may request a return or exchange only if:

items: Damaged Item: The product arrived with significant damage (see definitions below).
Wrong Item: We shipped an incorrect product.

blocks.text: You must notify us within 48 hours (2 days) of receiving your order.
How It Works

items: Time Limit: Contact us within 2 days of delivery.
Return Shipping: Customers cover the cost of returning the item.
Restocking Fee: A 15% fee will be deducted from your refund to cover processing and inspection costs.
Final Sale: Items marked “Final Sale” are non-returnable and non-exchangeable.

blocks.text: What Qualifies as “Damaged”?
– Structural Damage: Broken parts, cracks, or non-functional components caused during shipping.
– Manufacturing Defects: Flaws affecting usability (e.g., missing pieces, factory errors).
– Severe Cosmetic Damage: Major scratches, dents, or tears visible upon unboxing (minor wear during transit does not qualify).
– Incorrect/Missing Items: Received the wrong product or missing parts from a bundled order.
Note: Provide photos/video of the damage when contacting us.
Need Help?
Email us immediately at Sales@stnitenterprise.com with:
– Your order number.
– Photos/video of the issue.
– A brief description of the problem.
We’ll resolve your request within 3–5 business days!
Why These Rules?
We maintain strict policies to keep our prices competitive and ensure fair service for all customers. Every return is carefully inspected to uphold quality standards.

At STN IT Enterprise, we specialize in providing top-tier IT hardware designed to meet the demanding needs of modern businesses and large-scale enterprises. Our extensive portfolio covers everything from powerful servers and advanced storage solutions to reliable networking equipment and essential peripherals — all engineered to build a resilient, scalable, and secure IT infrastructure.
Our Core Hardware Offerings
Enterprise Servers

We supply high-performance rackmount and tower servers from leading brands, optimized for virtualization, application hosting, and mission-critical workloads. Whether you need IBM mainframes, Dell PowerEdge, or HP ProLiant servers, our solutions ensure maximum uptime and processing power tailored to your business demands.
Storage Solutions

Our enterprise storage hardware includes SAN, NAS, tape libraries, and virtual tape subsystems designed to safeguard your data with scalable capacity and fast access speeds. These solutions support your backup, archiving, and disaster recovery strategies effectively.
Networking Equipment

From enterprise-grade routers, switches, and gateways to wireless access points and network adapters, we provide the backbone for seamless, secure connectivity across your organization. Our networking hardware supports high throughput and robust security protocols essential for today’s digital environments.
IT Peripherals & Accessories
We also offer a wide range of peripherals including monitors, printers, UPS systems, and external storage devices to complement and enhance your IT ecosystem.

Comprehensive Support: From procurement to installation and ongoing maintenance, we provide end-to-end service.
